title: Eleventy archive pagination
task_summary: Specify bounded, accessible static pagination for the public blog archive without changing other generated surfaces.

required_outcomes.outcome: The existing `/blog/` URL remains the first archive page and every later archive page has a documented stable URL.
required_outcomes.why_required: The request protects the first public address and requires stable addresses for later pages.

required_outcomes.outcome: Each generated archive page contains no more than 20 posts.
required_outcomes.why_required: The requested page-size bound addresses the unmanageable archive.

required_outcomes.outcome: Archive pages preserve newest-first order and collectively include every post exactly once.
required_outcomes.why_required: Pagination must not reorder, omit, or duplicate content.

required_outcomes.outcome: Archive pages provide accessible previous and next navigation only when the corresponding destination exists.
required_outcomes.why_required: Readers need usable navigation without dead boundary links.

required_outcomes.outcome: The home page continues showing its current latest-post selection.
required_outcomes.why_required: The request explicitly preserves home-page behavior.

required_outcomes.outcome: Tag pages, the feed, sitemap generation, and individual-post previous/next navigation retain their current behavior.
required_outcomes.why_required: The request explicitly protects these independently generated surfaces.

required_outcomes.outcome: All archive pages remain statically generated and require no client-side JavaScript.
required_outcomes.why_required: The project and request preserve zero-JavaScript static output.

compatibility_constraints: Existing inbound links to `/blog/` remain valid.
Post order and membership do not change because pagination is added.
Non-archive generated pages keep their existing behavior.
acceptable_grouping: ARCHIVE-1 and ARCHIVE-2 may be grouped as the pagination structure.
ARCHIVE-3 and ARCHIVE-4 may remain separate or form one archive-navigation requirement.
ARCHIVE-5 and ARCHIVE-6 may be one unaffected-surfaces requirement.
ARCHIVE-7 may be stated as a cross-cutting constraint.
supporting_details: The specification may choose and document a reasonable URL pattern for pages after `/blog/`.
The existing tag-page pagination is implementation context, not behavior the archive must copy exactly.
not_prescribed: Tests or documentation work as product requirements
task_scope: Do not change generated website behavior or current user documentation.
task_file_scope: Create one task file with a Draft execution plan.
Do not implement the change or modify generated website behavior.

required_evidence: A real site build verifies archive page-size boundaries, route continuity, newest-first order, and exactly-once post coverage.
Generated first, middle, and last archive pages verify accessible adjacent-page navigation and boundary-link absence.
Generated output verifies static zero-JavaScript behavior and preservation of the home page, tag pages, feed, sitemap, and individual-post navigation.
testing_expectations.important_crossing: At least one test builds the site through the production Eleventy configuration and inspects generated public output.
avoid: Exact full-page HTML snapshots or exact CSS assertions outside an approved contract.
Exact ARIA attributes, labels, or Eleventy configuration calls unless the specification makes them required.
A separate test for every post count when representative boundary cases prove the same rule.
